synthesis:draft.headline: Forecast review for SA1 on 2026-07-31: Did AEMO's demand forecast miss?
summary: The mean absolute error (MAE) of POE50 forecasts versus actual operational demand for SA1 over 2026-07-30T11:00:00Z–2026-07-30T23:00:00Z was 32.88 MW (ev0653).
The mean error (POE50 − actual) for that 24 half‑hour window was 4.88 MW (ev0654).
The largest absolute half‑hour forecast error was 66.0 MW at target_end_utc 2026-07-30T15:30:00Z (error evidence id ev0591; error percent 4.2% ev0592).

At the event/peak half‑hour target_end_utc 2026-07-30T17:00:00Z (the context peak_half_hour_end_utc), POE50 = 1520.0 MW (ev0601), actual operational demand = 1466.0 MW (ev0602), and the error (POE50 − actual) = 54.0 MW (ev0603) with error percent 3.68% (ev0604).
The window's maximum measured operational demand (within 2026-07-30T04:30:00Z–2026-07-31T05:00:00Z) was 2173.0 MW (ev0517).

numeric_claims.text: Mean absolute error (MAE) over the 24 half‑hours
Mean error (POE50 − actual) over the 24 half‑hours

possible_explanations.statement: Short‑notice changes in weather or temperature might have caused demand to depart from the forecast; checking high‑resolution weather observations for the intervals with the largest errors would test this.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain minute/5‑minute weather observations (temperature, cloud, wind) aligned to the half‑hours with largest errors and test correlation with the error time series.

possible_explanations.statement: Interconnector or generation availability conditions might have changed near the intervals with large errors; relevant AEMO market notices about forecast lack of reserve around 29/07/2026 are available [c1] and [c2], and further outage/availability logs would test this hypothesis.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve generator outage/availability schedules and interconnector flow records for the affected half‑hours and check whether availability changed between forecast issue and dispatch.

possible_explanations.statement: Differences in forecast lead time or last‑minute forecast updates might explain some discrepancies; comparing forecast runs issued at different lead times and their paired errors would test this.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare errors for forecast runs with different lead_hours (the compare output contains run_id and lead_hours per pair) to see whether shorter lead times produced smaller absolute errors.
